Photo: Jeremias Kanz
22 September 2026|MIN-en
Wübben foundation supports student in attosecond physics
Starting October 1, the Wübben Stiftung Wissenschaft will award Felix Maximilian Gentsch a Student Grant for a total of twelve months. The physics student at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München was nominated by cluster spokesperson Prof. Francesca Calegari. The grant will enable him to conduct research within the Cluster...
Contribution from the news channel Advanced Imaging of Matter
Photo: DESY/ Kogler
22 September 2026|Research
How Long Does a Higgs Boson Live?
New analysis involving Quantum Universe researchers determines the Higgs boson’s lifetime to about 10% precision — something the Large Hadron Collider cannot measure directly.
Contribution from the news channel Quantum Universe
Photo: UHH/ Goertz
17 September 2026|International
Where Algebra Meets Strings: The CRC 1624 Summer School
Three weeks, 17 speakers from around the world, and over 120 participants gathered in Hamburg for an intensive program at the frontier of mathematics and theoretical physics.
